quote: these concepts were suggested (Reinhardt 1967, 1974) by American mathematician William Nelson Reinhardt
note: Reinhardt cardinals (of which the nontrivial elementary embedding V→V is a central example) were first formally introduced in Reinhardt's 1967 doctoral dissertation 'Topics in the metamathematics of set theory'. The question of whether such embeddings can exist without the axiom of choice (in ZF alone) remains open as of 2026.
